description: This file defines a REST API resource class for internal use in the Fineract project, specifically for retrieving audit information of clients. It uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Lombok for boilerplate code reduction, and references project-specific classes for serialization and data access.

classes.name: InternalClientInformationApiResource
classes.description: REST resource providing internal endpoints for fetching client audit details; marked with @Profile for test environment and uses dependency injection.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization callback that logs a warning indicating the API should not be used in production.

methods.name: getClientAuditFields
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve audit fields for a specific client by ID, returning JSON serialized audit metadata.
